Today, as a Staff Engineer at Septeo ADB, I lead the condominium management engineering team on Lobby: 90 property management firms, 681 users and 155,000 condominium owners.

work.name: Bellman
highlights: Designed and led a complete data model redesign to move from a single-tenant architecture to SaaS. Result: 90 clients migrated in production.
Built an engine to import data from competing software to remove a barrier to customer acquisition. Supported 10 software products. Reduced migration time from 6 months to 6–8 weeks.
Replaced the third-party provider with an in-house EBICS integration. Result: eliminated duplicate transactions and imported approximately 2 million bank transaction records.

work.name: Bellman
highlights: Test coverage: increased integration test coverage from 0 to 50% on a Node.js / Prisma codebase, significantly reducing production regressions.
Electronic cheque submission: built the automated processing module — 130,000 cheques processed.
Monthly service charge payments: implemented monthly payments for 18,000 condominium owners.
Critical business features: automated generation of CERFA forms, billing of property management fees and issuing formal notices.
